StockRotationExecutionItem.name: StockRotationExecutionItem
StockRotationExecutionItem.description: Represents the affected partner inventory in a stock rotation rebate execution, used to determine claim eligibility.

AcceptedQuantity.description: Specifies the quantity accepted for stock rotation in this line item.

CalculatedAmount.description: Specifies the simulated claim amount for this line item, calculated based on the claimable quantity.

ClaimableQuantity.description: Specifies the quantity eligible for claim under the stock rotation program.

EligibleQuantity.description: Specifies the quantity eligible for stock rotation in this line item.

HasWarnings.description: Indicates whether this line item has any warnings.

PartnerUnsoldInventory.description: Refers to the partner’s unsold inventory eligible for stock rotation.

PriceType.description: Indicates the price category of the eligible inventory.

Product.description: Specifies the product from the partner’s eligible unsold inventory.

ProgramRebateTypeEligibility.description: Specifies the program rebate type detail associated with this line item.

RebateClaim.description: Refers to the rebate claim generated for this line item.

RemainingQuantity.description: Specifies the quantity remaining in the partner’s unsold inventory.

SelectedDate.description: Specifies the date when the quantity was selected for stock rotation.

SelectedQuantity.description: Specifies the quantity selected for stock rotation in this line item.

Status.description: Indicates the current status of the line item (e.g., New, Quantity Submitted, Accepted).

StatusReason.description: Specifies the reason for the current status of the line item.

StockRotationExecution.description: Specifies the parent stock rotation execution record associated with this line item.

StockRotationMethod.description: Specifies the stock rotation method chosen by the partner (Return or Scrap).

TransactionReference.description: Specifies the reference object (e.g., Invoice/PUI) associated with this line item.

UnitPrice.description: Specifies the unit price of the product in the eligible inventory.

WarningMessage.description: Specifies the warning message associated with this line item if warnings exist.
